e: From Afghan + -ite, since it was discovered in Afghanistan.
Borrowed from Classical Persian افغانی (afġānī), derivative of افغان (afġān).
q: Laila hoped to have a thousand afghanis or more stowed away, half of which would go to the bus fare from Kabul to Peshawar.
